expect.words: As in a dream, you see yourself tumbling down a great, dark staircase. All about you are shadowy images of struggles against fierce opponents and diabolical traps. These give way to another round of images: of imposing stone figures, a cool, clear lake, and, now, of an old, yet oddly youthful man. He turns toward you slowly, his long, silver hair dancing about him in a fresh breeze. "You have reached the final test, my friend! You are proved clever and powerful, but this is not yet enough! Seek me when you feel yourself worthy!" The dream dissolves around you as his last words echo through the void....
Endless Stair

You are at the bottom of a seemingly endless stair, winding its way upward beyond your vision. An eerie light, coming from all around you, casts strange shadows on the walls. To the south is a dark and winding trail.
Your old friend, the brass lantern, is at your feet.
Taken.
The lamp is now on.
Junction

You are at the junction of a north-south passage and an east-west passage. To the north, you can make out the bottom of a stairway. The ways to the east and south are relatively cramped, but a wider trail leads to the west.
Standing before you is a great rock. Imbedded within it is an Elvish sword.
Who do you think you are? Arthur?

A great rock, grey and rounded and older than the passage it stands in, which was cut round it rather than through it; whoever did the cutting had tried the other way first and given up. Imbedded in it, to half its length, is an Elvish sword, the hilt standing out at a height that invites a hand. The rock has the look of a thing that has been invited many times.
Barren Area

You are west of the junction, where the rock-bound passage widens out into a large, flat area. Although the land here is barren, you can see vegetation to the west. South of here is a mighty wall of stone, ancient and crumbling. To the southwest the wall has decayed enough to form an opening, through which seeps a thin mist. A trail dips sharply into rocky terrain to the northwest.
Barren Area

You are west of the junction, where the rock-bound passage widens out into a large, flat area. Although the land here is barren, you can see vegetation to the west. South of here is a mighty wall of stone, ancient and crumbling. To the southwest the wall has decayed enough to form an opening, through which seeps a thin mist. A trail dips sharply into rocky terrain to the northwest.
You walk west toward the vegetation, and the mist comes down over it thicker with every step, until you cannot see the ground you are walking on and have to turn back to find it.
Land of Shadow

You are in a shadowy land of low, rolling hills stretching out to the west and south. The land is bordered to the north by a massive stone wall. Ancient and weathered, the wall has crumbled enough at one point to permit passage.
Land of Shadow

You are in a dark and shadowy land. All around you are gentle hills and eerie shadows. Far above, shrouded in mist, you can barely make out the ceiling of the enormous cavern that spans this entire land.
A cloaked and hooded person, carrying a sword not unlike your own, is standing blocking the way to the northwest.
The hooded figure has a great deal of strength, perhaps matching your own.
Through the shadows, a cloaked and hooded figure appears before you, blocking the northwestern exit from the room and carrying a brightly glowing sword.
From nowhere, the sword from the junction appears in your hand, wildly glowing!
You charge, but the hooded figure jumps nimbly aside.
You dodge as the hooded figure comes in low.
A quick stroke, but the hooded figure is on guard.
A brilliant feint puts you off guard, and the hooded figure slips its sword between your ribs. You are hurt very badly.
The hooded figure is hit with a quick slash!
The figure has a light wound which hasn't affected its seemingly great strength.
The hooded figure thrusts, but you fight back and send it flying to the ground!
A good parry! Your sword wounds the hooded figure!
The figure has some wounds and is probably not capable of hindering your movement.
The hooded figure catches you off guard and wounds you!
Your move was not quick enough and misses the mark.
The hooded figure tries to sneak past your guard, but you twist away.
A sharp thrust and the hooded figure is badly wounded!
The figure appears to be badly hurt and defenseless.
The hooded figure attempts a thrust, but its weakened state prevents hitting you.

You slowly remove the hood from your badly wounded opponent and recoil in horror at the sight of your own face, weary and wounded. A faint smile comes to the lips and then the face starts to change, very slowly, into that of an old, wizened person. The image fades and with it the body of your hooded opponent. The cloak remains on the ground.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
You are now wearing the cloak.
You are carrying:
A lamp (providing light)
An Elvish sword
A hood (being worn)
A cloak (being worn)
Land of Shadow

You are standing atop a steep cliff, looking west over a vast ocean. Far below, the surf pounds at a sandy beach. To the south and east are rolling hills filled with eerie shadows. A path cut into the face of the cliff descends toward the beach. To the north is a tall stone wall, which ends at the cliff edge. It was obviously built long ago, and directly north is a spot where you could climb over the rubble of the decaying wall.
Flathead Ocean

You are at the shore of an amazing underground sea, the topic of many a legend among adventurers. Few were known to have arrived at this spot, and fewer to return. There is a heavy surf and a breeze is blowing onshore. The land rises steeply to the east and quicksand prevents movement to the south. A thick mist covers the ocean and extends over the hills to the east. A path heads north along the beach.
An ancient Viking ship is passing along the shore, an old and crusty sailor at the helm.
Passing alongside the shore now is an old boat, reminiscent of an ancient Viking ship. Standing on the prow of the ship is an old and crusty sailor, peering out over the misty ocean.

The seaman looks up and maneuvers the boat toward shore. He cries out "I have waited three ages for someone to say those words and save me from sailing this endless ocean. Please accept this gift. You may find it useful!" He throws something which falls near you in the sand, then sails off toward the west, singing a lively, but somewhat uncouth, sailor song.
Flathead Ocean

You are at the shore of an amazing underground sea, the topic of many a legend among adventurers. Few were known to have arrived at this spot, and fewer to return. There is a heavy surf and a breeze is blowing onshore. The land rises steeply to the east and quicksand prevents movement to the south. A thick mist covers the ocean and extends over the hills to the east. A path heads north along the beach.
There is a vial here.
Taken.
It is a small, transparent vial which looks empty but is strangely heavy.

The path north along the beach runs between the surf and the rocks a little way, and is cut by a fall from the cliff above that the sea has made its own; you would have to swim the gap, and you have seen the surf. Not today.
Land of Shadow
You are in a land of dark shadows and shallow hills, which stretch out in all directions. To the west, the land dips sharply.
Land of Shadow
(You have been here before, so only the room's name is given. LOOK describes it again; VERBOSE describes every room in full every time, and BRIEF puts it back.)
Land of Shadow

You are standing atop a steep cliff, looking west over a vast ocean. Far below, the surf pounds at a sandy beach. To the south and east are rolling hills filled with eerie shadows. A path cut into the face of the cliff descends toward the beach. To the north is a tall stone wall, which ends at the cliff edge. It was obviously built long ago, and directly north is a spot where you could climb over the rubble of the decaying wall.

You climb over the rubble of the wall, and on the other side the mist is down so thick over the cliff-top that you cannot tell the ground from the drop, and you come back over the wall rather than find out which was which.
Land of Shadow
Land of Shadow
A stone wall blocks the way.
Land of Shadow

You are in a shadowy land of low, rolling hills stretching out to the west and south. The land is bordered to the north by a massive stone wall. Ancient and weathered, the wall has crumbled enough at one point to permit passage.
Barren Area
The trail dips sharply to the northwest into rocky terrain, and a little way down it the rocks have come across it in a slide too steep and too loose to cross. Not today.
Junction
Standing before you is a great rock.
The cramped way east runs a few yards and is choked with rock that came down from the roof some time ago; you get your light into the gap, and your arm, and no further. It will not be cleared today.
Creepy Crawl
You are in a dark and quite creepy crawlway with passages leaving to the north, east, south, and southwest.
Land of Shadow
You are at the eastern end of a dark, featureless landscape of shallow hills. Paths to the east and southeast reenter the rock.
Foggy Room
You are in a dank passage filled with a wispy fog. A spooky passageway leads north and a wider path heads off to the south. To the west, the path leaves the rock and enters an eerie, shadowy land.
Lake Shore

You are in a wide cavern on the north shore of a small lake. Some polished stone steps lead to the southeast and a sheer rock face prevents any movement around the lake to the southwest. The cavern is dimly lit from above.
Aqueduct View

This is a small balcony carved into a near-vertical cliff. To the east, stretching from north to south, stands a monumental aqueduct supported by mighty stone pillars, some of which are starting to crumble from age. You feel a sense of loss and sadness as you ponder this once-proud structure and the failure of the Empire which created this and other engineering marvels. Some stone steps lead up to the northwest.
Lake Shore
Go jump in a lake!
The shock of entering the frigid water has made you drop all your possessions into the lake!
On the Lake

You are floating on the surface of the lake. The water is ice cold and your ability to survive here for long is very questionable. A swim north puts you at your starting point. Conditions to the east are poor where the lake turns into swamp. The west and south shores are suitable for walking, however.
Nothing happens.
Underwater

You are below the surface of the lake. It turns out that the lake is quite shallow and the bottom is only a few feet below you. Considering the frigid temperature of the water, you should probably not plan an extended stay. The lake bottom is sandy and a few hearty plants and algae live there.
There is a brass lantern here.
There is an Elvish sword here.
There is a vial here.
Out of the corner of your eye, a small, shiny object appears in the sand. A moment later, it is gone!
There is no fish visible now.
Out of the corner of your eye, a small, shiny object appears in the sand. A moment later, it is gone!
The lamp is yours for a moment, but drops from your grasp.
You catch a brief glimpse of something shiny in the sand.
The icy waters are taking their toll. You will not be able to hold out much longer.
You run out of air and return to the surface.
On the Lake
You strike out to the south, and the shore there is further than it looked, and the cold is in your arms already; you turn back before it is too late, and the south shore keeps.
You strike out to the west, and the far shore is lost in the mist and the cold is in your arms already; you turn back before it is too late, and the western shore keeps.
You are becoming very weak. You had better leave the water before you drown!
Lake Shore
You are carrying:
A hood (being worn)
A cloak (being worn)
You are nearly paralyzed by the icy waters as you swim into the center of the lake.
On the Lake
Nothing happens.
Underwater
There is a brass lantern here.
There is an Elvish sword here.
There is a vial here.
You catch a brief glimpse of something shiny in the sand.
You reach the shiny object. It is a simple golden amulet!
A large and hungry-looking fish is swimming in the neighborhood.
You are already wearing it.
The icy waters are taking their toll. You will not be able to hold out much longer.
You run out of air and return to the surface.
On the Lake
Lake Shore
You have moved into a dark place.
It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Oh, no! A lurking grue slithered into the room and devoured you!
**** You have died ****

You find yourself deep within the earth in a barren prison cell. Outside the iron-barred window, you can see a great, fiery pit. Flames leap up and very nearly sear your flesh. After a while, footfalls can be heard in the distance, then closer and closer.... The door swings open, and in walks an old man.

He is dressed simply in a hood and cloak, wearing an amulet and ring, carrying an old book under one arm, and leaning on a wooden staff. A single key, as if to a massive prison cell, hangs from his belt.

He raises the staff toward you and you hear him speak, as if in a dream: "I await you, though your journey be long and full of peril. Go then, and let me not wait long!" You feel some great power well up inside you and you fall to the floor. The next moment, you are awakening, as if from a deep slumber.
Endless Stair
There is a brass lantern here.
Taken.
You are carrying:
A lamp
The lamp isn't functioning (probably from having gotten wet).
You have moved into a dark place.
It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Endless Stair

It is the brass lantern you have carried through two adventures already: battery-powered, dented in the places you remember, with a stout handle and a glass somebody has kept clean. It has the look of an old friend who has followed you somewhere it would rather not have come.
It has been in the lake, and it is the worse for it: there is water behind the glass and a smell of wet metal, and it will not light again.
The stairs are endless.
You have moved into a dark place.
It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Oh, no! A lurking grue slithered into the room and devoured you!
